Aladdin.name: Disney's Aladdin
Aladdin.summary: The Game Boy Color port of Disney's Aladdin is based on the Sega Genesis version.

Ballistic.name: Ballistic
Ballistic.summary: Ballistic (also known as Puzz Loop) is a tile-matching arcade puzzle game.

Carl Lewis Athletics 2000.name: Carl Lewis Athletics 2000
Carl Lewis Athletics 2000.summary: A track and field game for the Game Boy Color based around the Decathlon. It was only released in Europe.

Dino Breeder 4.name: Dino Breeder 4
Dino Breeder 4.summary: Dino Breeder 4 is a Japanese only Game Boy Color game developed by Digital Kids and published by J-Wing.

Rats!.name: Rats!
Rats!.summary: Reservoir Rat is a 2D platform video game.

Rayman - Mister Dark no Wana.name: Rayman
Rayman - Mister Dark no Wana.summary: The Game Boy Color version of Rayman remains true to the spirit of the original game, but makes some notable changes, particularly when compared to the original's bright, vibrant graphics. Some levels have also been modified or simplified from the original release.
